problems.problem: The backdrop is a generic two-tone studio wall/floor split with a plain horizon line behind the bottle. No equipment artifacts are present, but the environment is visually empty and does not express the tobacco-vanille warmth described in the palette; compared with references 3-5 (textured light play, sculptural material context), it reads as an unstyled draft backdrop rather than campaign scenery.

The left text stack (logo y=260, title y=350, subtitle y=460) is small, loosely spaced and visually disconnected from the product; the title (size 50, ~460px wide) has far less presence than headline typography in the references. No title/product overlap occurs (text_product_overlap.title=false), so the issue is weak hierarchy, not collision.

The contact detail crop [488,1105,1031,1355] shows the bottle base resting on the floor with only a very faint contact darkening beneath the base line; the contact shadow at opacity 0.35 / blur 10 is nearly invisible against the charcoal floor, so grounding is weak even though the bottle is not floating (base_y=1245, within the 91% limit, product_height_ratio 0.5903 in hero range).

Reference campaigns pair the hero bottle with tactile, light-sculpted environments (crinkled foil, carved wood, typographic fire backdrop). This poster's flat gradient wall plus isolated bottle leaves a visible design-quality gap.
